info.name: Gazebo - Purchasing Check Templates
info.description:
Admin / QA master data for goods-in QC questions (GFF001F).

**Tables:** `po_goods_in_check_template` + `po_goods_in_check_item`.

Each template is `(goods_in_type, storage_regime, scope, version)`. Floor `GET /purchasing/pos/:id/goods-in-form/` picks the latest **active** version. Do not edit questions on a version that already has submitted QC (`in_use=true`) — clone a new version instead.

**Auth:** Admin grant (`AdminAccess`). Warehouse floor users get 403.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{template_id}}`, `{{item_id}}`.

query.description: optional; omit or * for fallback NULL

request.description:
### List check templates

`GET /purchasing/check-templates/`

Admin catalogue of QC checklists. Example: list the current food header per storage regime so QA can open ambient vs chilled.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `goods_in_type` | no | `raw_material` \| `packaging` \| `other` |
| `storage_regime` | no | `ambient` \| `chilled` \| `frozen` \| `non_food`. Empty or `*` = fallback (regime NULL) |
| `scope` | no | `header` or `line` |
| `is_active` | no | `true` / `false` |
| `latest` | no | `true` = newest version only per key |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Check templates fetched successfully.` `data.count` plus `data.results[]` with `id`, `name`, `goods_in_type`, `storage_regime`, `scope`, `version`, `is_active`, `in_use`, `item_count`, `document`, `items[]` (`id`, `code`, `label`, `input_type`, `required`, `is_critical`, `fail_when`).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Invalid filter |
| 403 | Not an admin user |

### Get check template

`GET /purchasing/check-templates/:template_id/`

One checklist plus its questions. `in_use` is true when a delivery or adhoc session has already submitted QC against this version — then item writes return 409.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | yes | Template PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Check template fetched successfully.` Same object as a list row.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | Template not found |

### Create check template version

`POST /purchasing/check-templates/`

Publish a new version. Prefer `clone_from_id` so questions copy, then add/edit items on the new id. Creating from scratch requires `items`. Floor goods-in immediately uses the new active version.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clone_from_id` | no | Copy items and document block from this PK |
| `name` | if no clone | Display name |
| `goods_in_type` | if no clone | `raw_material` \| `packaging` \| `other` |
| `storage_regime` | no | `ambient` / `chilled` / `frozen` / `non_food` / null fallback |
| `scope` | if no clone | `header` or `line` |
| `items` | if no clone | Full question list |
| `deactivate_previous` | no | Default true — turns off other versions of the same key |
| `document_no` / `issue_no` / dates / `reason_for_change` | no | QMS document control |

**Response body**

`201` `Check template created successfully.` New template object (`version` incremented).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Missing name/items or invalid field |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | `clone_from_id` not found |
| 409 | Type/regime/scope/version already exists |

### Update check template

`PATCH /purchasing/check-templates/:template_id/`

Change name, `is_active`, or document-control fields. Allowed even when `in_use` is true (old QC stays stamped). `goods_in_type`, `storage_regime`, `scope`, and `version` are immutable — clone instead.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | yes | Template PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | no | Display name |
| `is_active` | no | Floor resolve ignores inactive |
| `document_no` / `issue_no` / dates / `reason_for_change` | no | QMS block |

**Response body**

`message`: `Check template updated successfully.` Updated template.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Saved |
| 400 | Tried to change type/regime/scope/version, or invalid field |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | Template not found |

### Add check item

`POST /purchasing/check-templates/:template_id/items/`

Add one question to a version that has **no** submitted QC. If `in_use` is true, clone a new version first.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | yes | Template PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | yes | Stable slug, e.g. `seal_ok` |
| `label` | yes | Question text shown on floor |
| `input_type` | yes | `bool` \| `decimal` \| `text` \| `date` |
| `required` | no | Default true |
| `is_critical` | no | Default false |
| `fail_when` | no | `false` \| `true` \| `out_of_range` |
| `min_value` / `max_value` | no | Decimal bounds |
| `source` | no | e.g. `product.temp_bounds` |
| `allows_comment` | no | Default true |
| `sort_order` | no | Display order |

**Response body**

`201` `Check item added successfully.` Item object including `id`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Invalid field |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | Template not found |
| 409 | Template in use, or code already exists |

### Update check item

`PATCH /purchasing/check-templates/:template_id/items/:item_id/`

Change label, required, fail rule, etc. on a version with no submitted QC.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | yes | Template PK |
| `item_id` | yes | Item PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` / `label` / `input_type` / `required` / `is_critical` / `fail_when` / `min_value` / `max_value` / `source` / `allows_comment` / `sort_order` | no | Same meaning as add item |

**Response body**

`message`: `Check item updated successfully.` Updated item.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Saved |
| 400 | Invalid field |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | Template or item not found |
| 409 | Template in use, or code clash |

### Delete check item

`DELETE /purchasing/check-templates/:template_id/items/:item_id/`

Remove a question from a version that has no submitted QC. Floor forms hide it on the next GET.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | yes | Template PK |
| `item_id` | yes | Item PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Check item deleted successfully.` `data.ref` = item id.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Deleted |
| 403 | Not an admin user |
| 404 | Template or item not found |
| 409 | Template in use |
